preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) > 0 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in a)
preconditions.description: Each string in array a is non-empty and consists only of lowercase English letters.
The total length of all strings in array a does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in output)
all(output[i] == sum(1 for l in range(1, len(a[i]) + 1) for r in range(l, len(a[i]) + 1) if sum(1 for s in a if s.find(a[i][l-1:r]) != -1) >= k) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each string a[i], the output integer is the count of substrings a[i][l...r] (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ |a[i]|) that appear in at least k strings in array a (including a[i] itself).
